claims: The 2026 Masters Tournament weekend coverage is on April 11-12.
Featured group coverage for the 2026 Masters Tournament weekend runs from roughly 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. daily on digital platforms including Masters.com, the Masters App, and Paramount+.
Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Saturday, April 11.
Featured Groups coverage for Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament runs from 10:15 a.m.–7 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Paramount+, and Prime Video.
"On the Range" coverage for Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament runs from 10 a.m.–noon ET on CBS Sports Network and Paramount+.
Early Coverage for Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament runs from 12–2 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
TV Coverage for Round 3 of the 2026 Masters Tournament runs from 2–7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Round 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament is on Sunday, April 12.
Featured Groups coverage for Round 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament runs from 10:15 a.m.–7 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Paramount+, and Prime Video.
Early Coverage for Round 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament runs from 12–2 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
TV Coverage for Round 4 of the 2026 Masters Tournament runs from 2–7 p.m. ET on CBS.
